title: Headless Tenpenny Tower (MS12, TTW 3.4): from Chief Gustavo's ghoul problem to Roy Phillips' ghouls killed and the reward (stages 200, 250)

actions.text: Given: the player is out of Vault 101 in the Capital Wasteland, Following in His Footsteps (MQ01) at its first stage (10) [observed]. MS12 is Start Game Enabled [observed]; the player is inside Tenpenny Tower (let in at the gate) with Chief Gustavo.

Path (Gustavo's job, the ghouls killed): Gustavo asked about the ghouls (MS12ResidentsGhouls: ghoulKnowledge) and the player offers help (MS12ResidentsGhoulsHelp, MS12ResidentsGhoulsHelpAccept: stage 10, AcceptGhoulJob, the Warrington Station map marker); Roy Phillips, Michael Masters and Bessie Lynn die (each OnDeath counts countGhoulsDead; at 3 allGhoulsDead, and the quest script sets 20); Gustavo's greeting for the dead ghouls pays (stage 200, then 250: the quest stops, MS12Fin starts). The other side, the ghouls let in (100, 120, the residents won over or the feral ghouls set loose through the tunnels), is not played. [observed: MS12 stage, INFO and object scripts on the TTW load order]
Stand-in for the walk to the Warrington Station and the fight with Roy Phillips' ghouls: the three die by the player's hand.
Stand-in for the walk back to Tenpenny Tower. Gustavo's greeting for the dead ghouls pays and sets 200 and 250.
